## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` is green and I added/updated a test for any server change
- [ ] `node --check` passes on every file I touched
- [ ] No new runtime dependency, no build step, no inline scripts/styles (CSP)
- [ ] Stays single-user in scope (no accounts / per-user separation / sharing between people)
- [ ] If the change is visible, I describe what I checked in a browser (and on a phone if it's mobile-related)
